# In-browser Java compiler (TeaVM)

These files let the app compile and run Java entirely in the browser. They
are copied to `public/vendor/teavm/` on `npm install` and served from the
app's own origin, like Pyodide and ONNX Runtime. Nothing here is loaded
from a third-party server.

| File | What it is | Source | sha256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `compiler.wasm` | OpenJDK's `javac` and the TeaVM compiler, compiled to one WebAssembly module | `https://teavm.org/playground/compiler.wasm`, built from [teavm-javac](https://github.com/konsoletyper/teavm-javac) (HEAD `0340fab`, file dated 2025-06-15) | `a79245353ac623df4fde5740bb2bedacedc9c98544253f01aa4b63268f9cb8ba` |
| `compiler.wasm-runtime.js` | TeaVM's loader for WebAssembly modules (used for the compiler and for compiled programs) | `https://teavm.org/playground/compiler.wasm-runtime.js` | `75b2b94394f162c384d42d540836375cdbb0207e6e5605b92a18ce56eb158741` |
| `runtime-classlib-teavm.bin` | TeaVM's implementation of the Java class library, linked into each program | `https://teavm.org/playground/runtime-classlib-teavm.bin` | `e62ab99ce291a3379abc0756a1e80f4796f00c60fee655e488b82e37b469d5b7` |
| `java-api.bin` | The Java 20 standard library API (signatures only) that `javac` compiles against | Built from a JDK's `lib/ct.sym` by `scripts/build-java-api.mjs` | `9e827a25bff5de1e6d2451cab67b69bcb798c2e83ab8285cecba76b702dae930` |

`java-api.bin` replaces the `compile-classlib-teavm.bin` that ships with
the TeaVM playground. That file is generated by renaming TeaVM's internal
classes and misses some links (for example `Map.Entry` and
`Throwable.getMessage()` can't be found), so ordinary interview code
didn't compile.

The files are committed rather than downloaded at install time because
teavm.org serves only unversioned "latest" builds.
